soil.title: Soil
soil.needs_lab_test: The evidence is not strong enough for a firm answer. A soil test (Soil Health Card) would settle it.
soil.image_model_unavailable: Photo-based soil identification is not available in this version.
soil.geo_source_unavailable: No geographical soil dataset is configured for your area.
soil.estimate_is_estimate: This is an estimate from the information available, not a laboratory test.
weather.title: Weather
market.title: Market
market.no_source: No verified market price source is configured. Prices are not guessed.
market.data_needed: To show prices, this app needs access to a verified mandi price feed.
rec.title: Crop recommendation
rec.pilot_plot: Because you have no record with us yet, try this on about {area} {unit} first.
rec.provisional: This recommendation is provisional: important data is missing.
rec.tied_options: The top {count} options scored almost the same. Because some data was unavailable, treat them as equally uncertain rather than as a ranking.
rec.stale_disclaimer: Some of the data behind this recommendation is not current, because the source could not be reached. Those values are listed with their age.
rec.stale_weather: The weather forecast is about {hours} hours old, not a current forecast.
rec.stale_price: The market prices are about {hours} hours old, not current prices.
rec.weather_unavailable: Weather could not be retrieved, so weather match was not scored.
rec.return_unavailable: Expected return in rupees is not estimated: this version does not collect per-crop yield and cost inputs yet.
reason.soil_suitable: The soil you reported suits this crop.
reason.soil_marginal: The soil you reported is only partly suited to this crop.
reason.soil_unknown: Soil type is not known, so soil suitability could not be scored.
reason.water_fits: The crop's water need fits your {irrigation} situation.
reason.water_short: This crop needs more water than your situation appears to provide.
reason.season_matches: This crop is normally grown in the {season} season.
reason.season_mismatch: This crop is normally not grown in the {season} season.
reason.weather_favourable: The current forecast is not hostile to this crop.
reason.weather_unfavourable: Some forecast days fall outside this crop's preferred temperature range.
reason.weather_unavailable: The weather forecast was unavailable, so it was not used.
reason.weather_stale: The weather forecast came from the last saved response and may be out of date.
reason.price_stable: Recent prices for this crop are relatively steady.
reason.price_volatile: Recent prices for this crop move a lot, which raises risk.
reason.price_unavailable: No verified price data is available, so returns could not be estimated.
reason.price_stale: These prices came from the last saved response and may be out of date.
reason.price_unmeasured: This crop's price signal has not been backtested yet, so its market weight uses a conservative default.
reason.community_ok: Few growers using this app in your district have taken this crop.
reason.community_saturated: Many growers using this app in your district have already taken this crop this season.
reason.community_unknown: Regional production data is unavailable, so oversupply risk is unknown.
reason.history_good: This crop has worked reasonably for you before.
reason.history_poor: This crop has not done well for you before.
reason.no_history: You have no recorded outcomes with us yet.
data.sample_banner: DEMO DATA - this is sample data, not real prices or weather.
data.farmer_reported: You reported this. It has not been independently verified.
data.unknown_region: We do not have verified data for this district yet.
limits.guarantee: This is an estimate, not a guarantee. Prices and weather can change.
limits.decision_support: You make the decision. This app only helps you compare options.
limits.no_model_accuracy_claim: No accuracy figure is claimed for the models in this version.
feedback.saved: Thank you - this helps the system check itself.
outcome.title: Season result
pop.unavailable: Verified package-of-practices data for this crop is not yet sourced from an authoritative publication, so sowing window, seed rate and fertilizer figures are not shown.
